registered_addition_groups.rationale: Deterministic canonical SHA-256 encoding for immutable prediction/error source snapshots, validation/appraisal trace material, and detached source digests. The bridge is read-only, installs no runtime hook, does not call predict/observe/tick, registers no production verifier, performs no persistence/event append, and cannot claim production provenance, retained-real coverage, observation-window state, M3 completion, or cutover authority.
